indicators: SPF fail for ceo@contoso.com with source IP 192.0.2.45
No DKIM signature present in email headers
DMARC policy set to reject but email passed as none, indicating spoof
Email originated from unexpected IP outside legitimate mail servers
Urgent wire transfer request with unusual urgency and no secondary confirmation
Email X-Originating-IP header shows external IP unusual for internal CEO mail
Email monitoring system alert for spoofed CEO email
Wire transfer to unknown vendor account immediately after spoofed email
examples.detection_method: Implement automated email authentication checks (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) with strict enforcement; correlate email origin IP against known legitimate mail servers; flag and quarantine emails failing authentication from high-risk senders (executives, finance); alert SOC analysts; verify all wire transfer requests with multi-factor secondary communication (e.g. phone call to known number); monitor unusual wire transfer activity in financial systems; deploy email gateway solutions with spoof detection and anomaly scoring; train finance team to report suspicious emails and verify out-of-band.
